content.text: {"regions": [{"id": "r2", "type": "stanza_note", "lines": [{"n": 1, "text": "उद्यमं बिभ्रतीति; सोद्यमा इत्यर्थः । स्वार्थाविरोधेन—विरोधस्याभावः अविरोधः;", "end": "space"}, {"n": 2, "text": "स्वार्थेन अविरोधः, तेन i. e. without sacrificing their own good.", "end": "space"}, {"n": 3, "text": "स्वार्थाय—i. e. स्वार्थं साधयितुम्. See note on हिताय sl. 72.", "end": "space"}], "uncertain": false, "note": null}, {"id": "r3", "type": "stanza_note", "lines": [{"n": 1, "text": "Sl. 75. पुरा—at first, i. e. before it was placed on fire. ताप—", "end": "space"}, {"n": 2, "text": "(1) heat; (2) trouble. हि—अवधारणे Mark !; or, surely, verily.", "end": "space"}, {"n": 3, "text": "उन्मनस्—eager. तेन जलेन युक्तम्—reunited with the same water.", "end": "space"}, {"n": 4, "text": "शाम्यति—becomes calm, settles down. The stanza draws a very", "end": "space"}, {"n": 5, "text": "nice moral lesson from a common occurrence in the kitchen. The", "end": "space"}, {"n": 6, "text": "milk on being well heated begins to boil over; but if water is added", "end": "space"}, {"n": 7, "text": "to it, it settles down. The fig.s are क्रियास्वरूपोत्प्रेक्षा supported by", "end": "space"}, {"n": 8, "text": "अर्थान्तरन्यास.", "end": "space"}], "uncertain": false, "note": null}, {"id": "r4", "type": "stanza_note", "lines": [{"n": 1, "text": "Sl. 76. इतः—when repeated this has the sense of here-there,", "end": "space"}, {"n": 2, "text": "in one place, in another केशव or विष्णु is called जलशायी ( Amara )", "end": "space"}, {"n": 3, "text": "and क्षीराब्धिनिवासी. कुलं-family, a host of (सजातीयैः कुलम् ). तदीय-", "end": "hyphen"}, {"n": 4, "text": "द्विषाम्—Of Kes'ava’s enemies, the demons. For the account of", "end": "space"}, {"n": 5, "text": "the Kâlakeyas hiding themselves in the sea, see Mah. Bhar. Van.", "end": "space"}, {"n": 6, "text": "P. 101, 105. शरणार्थिनः &c.—chains of mountains seeking shelter", "end": "space"}, {"n": 7, "text": "( scil. from the wrath of Indra ). See notes on sl. 36. Comp.", "end": "space"}, {"n": 8, "text": "पक्षच्छिदा गोत्रभिदात्तगन्धाः शरण्यमेनं शतशो महीध्राः । नृपा इवोपप्लविनः परेभ्यो", "end": "space"}, {"n": 9, "text": "धर्मोत्तरं मध्यममाश्रयन्ते ॥ According to the Hariv. Mainâka appears", "end": "space"}, {"n": 10, "text": "to be the only mountain that took refuge in the sea. The poets", "end": "space"}, {"n": 11, "text": "speak of more mountains as having taken refuge probably only", "end": "space"}, {"n": 12, "text": "to magnify the greatness of the sea. संवर्तकैः—with the fires that", "end": "space"}, {"n": 13, "text": "destroy the world at the end of the creation. The commentator", "end": "space"}, {"n": 14, "text": "Rámarshi gives to this word the sense सकलजलचरजीवविशेष, in", "end": "space"}, {"n": 15, "text": "addition, but this is quite obscure. संवर्त is also a particular", "end": "space"}, {"n": 16, "text": "cloud though it is not intended here. For वडवानल see Matsya", "end": "space"}, {"n": 17, "text": "Puràṇa CLXXIV. 49. et. seq. and Mis. sl. 9. भर०—सहते इति सहं", "end": "space"}, {"n": 18, "text": "भरस्य सहं भर० able to bear a great load, mighty. This may be", "end": "space"}, {"n": 19, "text": "looked upon as an instance of अप्रस्तुतप्रशंसा the अप्रस्तुत not being", "end": "space"}, {"n": 20, "text": "directly mentioned.", "end": "space"}], "uncertain": false, "note": null}, {"id": "r5", "type": "stanza_note", "lines": [{"n": 1, "text": "Sl. 77. In line 3 the Nirnayasâgar Edition reads प्रख्यापय", "end": "space"}, {"n": 2, "text": "for प्रच्छादय which will suit only with the reading प्रश्रयम् for", "end": "space"}], "uncertain": false, "note": null}, {"id": "r1", "type": "page_number", "lines": [{"n": 1, "text": "( 30 )", "end": "space"}], "uncertain": false, "note": null}], "units": [{"id": "u1", "type": "notes", "number": null, "label": null, "open_start": true, "open_end": true, "children": ["u2", "u3", "u4", "u5"]}, {"id": "u2", "type": "stanza_note", "number": null, "label": null, "open_start": true, "open_end": false, "children": ["r2"]}, {"id": "u3", "type": "stanza_note", "number": "75", "label": "Sl. 75", "open_start": false, "open_end": false, "children": ["r3"]}, {"id": "u4", "type": "stanza_note", "number": "76", "label": "Sl. 76", "open_start": false, "open_end": false, "children": ["r4"]}, {"id": "u5", "type": "stanza_note", "number": "77", "label": "Sl. 77", "open_start": false, "open_end": true, "children": ["r5"]}], "flows": [{"flow": "main", "units": ["u1"]}], "relations": []}
